papers.title_en: FENAS: A Few-Shot Meta-Ensembling Framework for Efficient Neural Architecture Search with Synergized Zero-Cost Proxies
papers.authors: Yifeng Mao, Yuze Feng, Yutong Shen, Liyang Gao, Zhixiang He
papers.evidence: 基于零成本代理的少样本神经架构搜索
papers.tldr: 针对有限预算下 NAS 性能估计难题，现有零成本代理仅反映架构局部特性，跨数据集排名不稳定，而 GNN 预测器依赖标注与图编码，难以适应极端少样本。FENAS 提出拓扑无关的少样本预测框架，其核心 CAST 通过 copula 对齐与协同变换，将异构零成本代理映射为紧凑特征流形，供轻量元学习器生成可靠排序。在 NAS-Bench-201 仅用 0.5% 标注时，FENAS 取得 0.70 的 Kendall's Tau，并约 1138 秒完成搜索空间评估。该工作以简单高效机制提升少样本架构排序与搜索实用性。
papers.abstract_en: Efficient neural architecture search (NAS) requires accurate performance estimation under limited evaluation budgets. Existing zero-cost proxies (ZCPs) provide fast training-free signals, but each proxy usually captures only a partial property of an architecture, leading to unstable rankings across datasets and search spaces. In contrast, GNN-based predictors can improve accuracy, but often depend on labeled architectures, graph encoders, and costly representation learning, which makes them less suitable for extreme few-shot settings. We propose FENAS, a topology-agnostic few-shot prediction framework that turns complementary initialization priors into robust ranking signals. Its core component, CAST, is a feature pipeline that combines copula alignment and synergy transformation. CAST maps heterogeneous ZCPs into a compact feature manifold, enabling lightweight meta-learners to produce reliable rankings from scarce supervision. On NAS-Bench-201, with only 0.5% labeled samples, FENAS achieves a Kendall's Tau ($τ$) of 0.70, outperforming representative topology-based few-shot predictors in this low-label regime. In closed-domain search, FENAS evaluates the NAS-Bench-201 space in approximately 1138 seconds and achieves competitive test accuracy. By providing a fast, reliable, and structurally simple evaluation mechanism, FENAS supports the design of automated neural architectures under limited evaluation budgets.

papers.title_en: HWAM: Humanoid World Action Model With Joint State--Action Generation
papers.authors: Yan Yang, Jikun Rong, Minzhao Zhu, Zheyi Zhao, Qirui Hu, Zihan Lan, Weixin Mao, Yinhao Li, Zhen Fu, Hua Chen
papers.evidence: 联合状态-动作生成的人形世界动作模型
papers.tldr: 人形机器人分层系统中，策略输出参考动作需经全身控制、动力学与平衡执行，导致参考动作与实际运动间存在执行差距，使世界模型难以将动作与物理结果关联。HWAM 将机器人执行后的本体感知状态作为显式预测目标，联合生成参考动作与实际体态，并采用策略、前向动力学与逆向动力学三条条件路径训练。在 LimX OLI 三项真实机器人任务中取得最高成功率，Candy Picking 达 70.6%，显著优于 Fast-WAM 的 43.3%。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots are a promising platform for general-purpose manipulation. Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies learn actions directly from multimodal observations, while World Action Models (WAMs) further incorporate future visual prediction to improve action generation. However, in hierarchical humanoid systems, VLA and WAM policies output reference actions that are subsequently realized through whole-body control, robot dynamics, balance, and contact. This hierarchy creates an action--execution gap: the reference produced by the policy can differ from the motion realized by the robot. Without explicitly modeling the realized body state, future visual prediction must jointly explain scene evolution and discrepancies between reference actions and executed motion, making it difficult to associate an action with its physical outcome. We propose HWAM, a Humanoid World Action Model with joint state--action generation, which makes the robot's post-execution proprioceptive state an explicit prediction target. By jointly generating reference actions and their realized body states, HWAM directly incorporates supervision of executed motion into action learning. HWAM is trained through three complementary conditional paths. The Policy path jointly denoises state--action trajectories conditioned only on current observations, matching deployment conditions. Forward Dynamics Modeling (FDM) predicts future visual observations conditioned on actions and post-execution states, while Inverse Dynamics Modeling (IDM) reconstructs the joint trajectory from visual transitions. Together, these paths connect policy references, realized body motion, and visual outcomes. HWAM achieves the highest success rate among evaluated baselines on three real-robot tasks on the LimX OLI humanoid. On Candy Picking, HWAM achieves a 70.6% success rate, compared with 43.3% for Fast-WAM.

papers.title_en: SafeDiSTL: Decomposing Joint Constraints for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Hongrui Zheng, Aditya Singh, Rahul Mangharam
papers.evidence: 带联合安全约束的约束多智能体强化学习
papers.tldr: 协作多智能体任务常受共享目标或集体安全约束，但团队级违规代价难以分辨各智能体动作的责任。SafeDiSTL利用信号时序逻辑STL鲁棒性度量回合级违规，并通过平滑全回合鲁棒性与可微动力学获得动作敏感度。该方法按同一决策时刻将成本增量分配给各智能体，并计入延迟影响。在运输、导航与交通控制任务中，它显著提升安全成功率与吞吐量，同时保持无约束策略性能。
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative multi-agent tasks often impose constraints on a shared objective or collective safety. A team level violation cost function can measure this constraint outcome, but does not distinguish which agents' actions most strongly influence that violation. We present SafeDiSTL, a constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that allows for credit assignment even with joint constraint measurements. We use Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness to measure episode-level violation through running-maximum cost increments. Smooth full-episode robustness and differentiable dynamics provide action sensitivities, which allocate each cost increment across agents at the same decision time. These sensitivities account for delayed effects when weighting agents' shares of each cost increment. We study the framework in cooperative payload transport, connected navigation, and networked traffic control tasks. SafeDiSTL achieves 1.6-5.1x the safe-success rate in transport, improves navigation safe-success by 11.1%, and delivers 50-68% more throughput in traffic when compared to constrained baselines. Results demonstrate a strong improvement of the learned policy in dealing with shared constraint while retaining the performance of unconstrained policies.

papers.title_en: Deep learning from a control vantage point
papers.authors: Álvaro Rodríguez Abella, João Pedro Silvestre, Bahman Gharesifard, Paulo Tabuada
papers.evidence: 残差网络视为控制系统的离散化
papers.tldr: 本文从控制论视角综述深度学习最新进展，涵盖前馈/残差网络、Transformer、大语言模型与选择性状态空间模型。核心桥梁是把残差网络看作连续时间控制系统的离散化，把Transformer看作共识算法的离散化，并把反向传播与最优控制相联系。借助几何非线性控制，可把残差网络的通用逼近能力刻画为非标准可控性问题；大语言模型因而呈现共识行为。文章还调和了80年代离散模型与近期连续模型两种反向传播-最优控制联系，并讨论未来方向。
papers.abstract_en: This article offers an overview of recent developments in deep learning from a control vantage point. It reviews several classes of models including feedforward and residual neural networks, transformers, large-language models, and selective state space models while explaining how control theory plays an important role in understanding their training, properties, or architecture design. The article explains how residual neural networks can be interpreted as the discretization of a continuous-time control system thereby enabling the use of control theoretic techniques for its analysis. To illustrate the power of this bridge between control and deep learning, two technical results are discussed: 1) the ability of a residual neural network to approximate arbitrary continuous functions is a non-standard controllability problem that can be solved using geometric nonlinear control and 2) transformers, the key architectural component of most large language-models, can be seen the discretization of a consensus algorithm and thus large language-models exhibit consensus. Another point of contact between control theory and deep learning is the connection between backpropagation, the algorithm used to train neural networks, and optimal control. The article addresses how the older connection between these problems, established in the 80's using discrete-time models can be reconciled with the more recent approach using continuous-time models. Several open problems and directions for future research are discussed, including selective state-space models, a recent class of models inspired by the models used in control.

papers.title_en: From Video to Vision: Learning Generalizable Humanoid Carrying from Human Motion
papers.authors: Ziluo Ding
papers.evidence: 从人类运动学习可泛化人形搬运的多阶段RL框架
papers.tldr: 现有基于视频或动捕的人形搬运强化学习依赖上层实时生成参考轨迹，且只能在指定位置搬运，空间泛化差，策略也难脱离动捕棚。MOVER提出多阶段Teacher-Assistant-Student强化学习框架，先利用GENMO与GMR重定向视频并增强数据，再经DeepMimic跟踪、放宽跟踪与Dagger-PPO蒸馏，使策略仅凭机载RGB-D感知物体位姿。仿真显示分阶段与蒸馏后成功率提升，并成功迁移到真机，在无动捕环境下搬运不同位置物体。
papers.abstract_en: Most existing approaches rely on video or motion-capture data for reinforcement learning (RL) training; however, all of these methods require an upper-level module to generate reference trajectories in real time. In object carrying tasks, the humanoid can only lift objects from designated locations along the reference trajectory, resulting in poor spatial generalization. Moreover, existing policies can only be evaluated inside a motion-capture studio. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{MOVER}, a multi-stage, Teacher-Assistant-Student, RL training framework for humanoid object carrying. We first collect data from videos and employ GENMO and GMR to retarget the video data, combining this with data augmentation techniques to generalize the data across objects of varying shapes and sizes. In the \textbf{first stage}, building upon the DeepMimic \cite{peng2018deepmimic} motion-training framework, we train the humanoid to transport objects from specified locations along designated trajectories. In the \textbf{second stage}, we relax the tracking of the reference motion and adjust the reward so that the humanoid learns to transport objects from different positions. In the \textbf{third stage}, we apply a Dagger-PPO distillation method to distill away the proprioceptive position observations and reference joint position of the humanoid. This allows the deployed policy to operate without relying on global position information from a motion-capture system; instead, the humanoid can directly perceive the object's pose from its onboard RGB-D camera to complete the carrying task. We design a series of simulation experiments to compare the success rates across stages (Stages 1 vs. 2) and before versus after distillation. We further transfer the policy to a real humanoid, successfully transporting objects at varying positions in a motion-capture-free setting.

papers.title_en: Push the Limit: Learning High-Speed Sprinting and Aggressive Cornering on a Full-Scale Humanoid
papers.authors: Huaxing Huang, Ruidong Li, Jinchao Han, Ziyang Dong, Wenhao Cui
papers.evidence: 全尺寸人形机器人的学习型高速冲刺与激进转弯
papers.tldr: 全尺寸人形机器人高速奔跑与转向面临难题：约4 m/s以上足部冲击引发高频偏航振荡，破坏本体感觉历史，并使传统偏航率跟踪奖励失效；单一风格先验也难以兼顾不同技能。为此，作者采用因果多头注意力建模高频时序反馈，以航向方向奖励监督低频速度方向，并引入技能条件多对抗运动先验判别器。在仿真与真机上实现超7 m/s冲刺及躯干倾斜25°的高速激进转向。消融表明各机制缺一不可，兼顾速度与参考运动保真度。
papers.abstract_en: We present a learning-based framework that enables a full-scale bipedal humanoid to sprint at over 7 m/s with motion-prior-guided gait and perform aggressive cornering at high speed with a pronounced trunk lean of up to $25^\circ$. Achieving this combination is challenging: above approximately 4 m/s, periodic foot impacts induce severe, high-frequency yaw-rate oscillations intrinsic to high-speed gaits. This high-frequency temporal structure corrupts the history of proprioceptive feedback that flat-MLP policies rely on, while rendering conventional yaw-rate tracking rewards counterproductive, as they fight against the robot's natural oscillatory dynamics. Moreover, a single style prior shared across skills cannot tell which skill is commanded and inherently compromises the low-speed skill fidelity. To overcome these limitations, we adopt a causal multi-head attention (MHA) module to explicitly model the high-frequency temporal feedback. In place of the oscillatory yaw rate, we design a heading-direction reward that supervises only the low-frequency velocity direction, allowing agile turning at high speed without suppressing natural gait oscillations. We further introduce skill-conditioned multi-adversarial-motion-prior (MAMP) discriminators that condition the style reward on the commanded skill. Ablation experiments confirm that each mechanism is essential: replacing structured temporal encoding with a flat-history MLP caps the top speed; reverting to yaw-rate tracking prevents high-speed turning; and a single shared discriminator makes in-place turning collapse into a quasi-static stance. Our framework bridges the gap between raw sprinting speed and reference-motion fidelity, demonstrating stable high-speed sprinting and aggressive cornering in both simulation and real-robot deployment.

papers.title_en: Test-Time Compute for Humanoid Behavior Foundation Models
papers.authors: Weiji Xie, Junsong Wu, Zibo Zhou, Yueru Chen, Xingyi Wang, Zhenhua Xiong, Weinan Zhang, Chenjia Bai
papers.evidence: 经仿真对人形行为基础模型做测试时优化
papers.tldr: 人形行为基础模型（BFM）能执行动作，但下游loco-manipulation需高全身定位精度，现有模型存在系统性指令-执行偏差。本文提出测试时命令优化（TTCO），通过闭环仿真采样搜索输入命令，无需重训即可缩小执行与目标轨迹差距。在AMASS上三个BFM中，TTCO将平均全局身体位置误差降低79-84%，并给出计算最优扩展策略。TTCO还能从机器人轨迹生成BFM专属动作标签，用于训练高层loco-manipulation并复用演示。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) can execute impressive motions, but downstream applications such as loco-manipulation demand high whole-body positional accuracy. Existing BFMs suffer from a systematic command-execution gap, where executed motions deviate from desired ones. We show that additional test-time compute can improve execution without retraining the BFM. First, we introduce Test-Time Command Optimization (TTCO), which adapts the input command to the specific BFM to produce an executed trajectory closer to the desired motion. TTCO finds such commands by sampling-based optimization through closed-loop simulations of the BFM and robot dynamics. Across three BFMs on the AMASS dataset, TTCO reduces mean global body-position error by 79-84% in simulation. Second, we analyze test-time compute scaling and derive an approximate compute-optimal strategy that can sustain performance gains as the compute budget increases. Third, TTCO can generate BFM-specific action labels from recorded robot trajectories without requiring the original teleoperation body-motion commands. Simulation and real-robot experiments show that these labels are effective for training high-level loco-manipulation policies. This method also supports reusing existing demonstrations across BFMs.

papers.title_en: Phase-Gated Constrained Reinforcement Learning for End-to-End Capture and Detumbling of Non-Cooperative Targets
papers.authors: Álvaro Belmonte-Baeza, Celia Redondo-Verdú, José L. Ramón, Miguel Cazorla, Leonard Felicetti, Jorge Pomares
papers.evidence: 带硬安全约束的约束强化学习策略完成全任务
papers.tldr: 主动碎片清除要求服务航天器逼近、捕获并消旋非合作翻滚目标，传统方法需分阶段控制器并依赖惯量或专用抓手。本文提出相位门控约束强化学习，用单一策略完成自由空间接近、无夹具摩擦捕获到完全消旋，目标质量惯量未知且状态含噪。在约束MDP的奖励、动作空间和约束集三处引入平滑接近门，诱导相位结构、硬性阻止抓取拉拽漏洞并修复约束归一化失效。1000次随机试验成功率99.5%，全程满足接触力等限制，并零样本迁移与十倍质量外推。
papers.abstract_en: Active debris removal requires a servicer spacecraft to approach a non-cooperative tumbling object, capture it, and arrest its rotation. This sequence is conventionally divided among phase-specific controllers, each depending on knowledge of the target's inertia, a dedicated grappling fixture, or a hand-designed switch at the contact-rich seam where such pipelines are most fragile. We show that a single constrained reinforcement learning policy can execute the entire mission, driving a dual-arm free-flying servicer from free-space closing through friction-based fixture-free capture to full detumbling of a target whose mass and inertia are unknown and whose state is observed only through noisy estimates. The enabling mechanism is a smooth proximity gate applied at three loci of a constrained Markov decision process. In the reward it induces the phase structure rather than imposing it; in the action space it forecloses a degenerate grab-and-pull exploit as a hard guarantee; and in the constraint set it resolves a normalization failure of constraint-based learning, in which a constraint spanning phases that load it unequally is rendered nearly inert in the phase where precision matters most. Both the failure mode and the remedy apply to any multi-phase problem of this kind. Over 1000 randomized trials the policy succeeds in 99.5% while holding its contact-force, actuator, base-reaction and collision limits throughout, transfers zero-shot to unseen geometries and centre-of-mass offsets, and extrapolates across a tenfold range of target mass.

papers.title_en: Walk Like This: Stylized Locomotion for Physics-Based Characters through Example-Driven Diffusion
papers.authors: Joshua Aurand, Agon Serifi, Sammy Christen, Ruben Grandia, Espen Knoop, Marco Hutter, Moritz Bächer
papers.evidence: 扩散生成运动并由RL控制器跟踪
papers.tldr: 现有数据驱动机器人运动控制器通常需要显式风格标签才能训练，难以利用大规模无标注动捕数据，也无法泛化到未见风格。本文提出实时框架，用定制采样策略训练风格编码器，将风格与功能性行走解耦，并以自回归扩散模型生成运动学参考，再由强化学习控制器跟踪。用户只需输入风格参考片段与摇杆速度指令，即可独立控制速度与风格，并在仿真人形与真实机器人上实现稳健实时控制与连续风格调制。
papers.abstract_en: We present a real-time framework for expressive legged locomotion that enables independent control over velocity and style. Unlike existing data-driven controllers, which typically require explicit style labels for training, our method efficiently leverages large-scale unstructured motion data and generalizes to unseen styles. We disentangle style from functional locomotion through a tailored sampling strategy used to train a style encoder whose output conditions an autoregressive diffusion model. During inference, the user provides a style reference clip and a joystick velocity command. The diffusion model then generates a kinematic reference tracked by a reinforcement learning controller. To improve user controllability and stylization strength, we propose an attention biasing mechanism and a velocity command correction strategy. We demonstrate our method on a physics-based humanoid character in simulation and on a physical robot, showcasing robust real-time control and continuous style modulation. The results can be best seen in our supplemental video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=roFnS6N7nJ4).

papers.title_en: TRACE: Efficient Transfer Learning for Neural Whole-Body Control Across Humanoid Embodiments
papers.authors: Qingyu Lan, Zhihao Tian, Zifan Wang, Junwei Liang
papers.evidence: 跨形态神经全身人形控制
papers.tldr: 人形行为基础模型可完成多样全身控制，但迁移到新机体常因运动学与动力学差异而困难。TRACE 通过注入运动学先验、对齐关节动力学，并结合编码器蒸馏与低秩强化学习，在精简筛选动作集上分两阶段微调。它将 SONIC 从 Unitree G1 迁移到 Unitree H2，仅用约八小时单卡训练，在六万余动作上达 96.08% 成功率。该工作证明预训练控制器可低成本跨机体复用，并支撑真机遥操作与下游 VLA 策略后训练。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid behavior foundation models (BFMs) enable diverse whole-body control, but adapting a pretrained controller to a new embodiment remains challenging because of kinematic and dynamic mismatch. We present TRACE, a framework for efficient cross-embodiment adaptation that preserves pretrained motion representations while specializing feedback control to the target robot.TRACE first injects kinematic priors into input and output projection layers and aligns nominal joint dynamics to reduce embodiment mismatch and support stable fine-tuning. It then combines encoder distillation with low-rank reinforcement learning on a compact, quality-screened motion set, using a two-phase curriculum to establish stable tracking before refining difficult motions. We apply TRACE to transfer SONIC from Unitree G1 to Unitree H2 using 10 million motion frames and approximately eight hours of training on a single RTX PRO 6000 GPU, at less than 0.1% of the GPU-hour cost of training SONIC from scratch. The adapted controller achieves 96.08\% success on 67,953 evaluation motions under a height-scaled tracking criterion. Real-robot demonstrations span dynamic motion tracking and whole-body teleoperation, with collected demonstrations supporting downstream vision-language-action policy post-training. These results demonstrate practical reuse of a pretrained humanoid controller across robots with different body scales and dynamics.

papers.title_en: Hamiltonian Primal-Dual Policy Reinforcement Learning for Derivative-Free Model-Based Control
papers.authors: K. Rabiei, Z. Rui, X. Lu, W. Hao
papers.evidence: 将哈密顿最优控制与基于模型的强化学习策略优化相结合
papers.tldr: 当动态模型可仿真但导数不可用、不连续或不可靠时，有限时域最优控制变得困难。HPDPO是一种无导数、基于模型的强化学习框架，用确定性后缀滚动评估动作，并用正则化哈密顿对偶提供未来代价信息。在非光滑解析问题、ReLU生物标志物级联、ADNI淀粉样蛋白Neural ODE及最多五个控制的多维问题上，它复现了精确或参考目标值、轨迹和控制结构。这表明前向仿真与哈密顿对偶结构可结合求解非光滑、学习或黑箱动态的确定性有限时域控制。
papers.abstract_en: Finite-horizon optimal control becomes difficult when a dynamical model can be simulated reliably, but its derivatives are unavailable, discontinuous, or unreliable. Hamiltonian Primal-Dual Policy Optimization (HPDPO) is introduced as a derivative-free, model-based reinforcement learning framework for this setting. The control is represented as a time-indexed finite-horizon policy. Candidate actions are evaluated by deterministic suffix rollouts of the supplied transition model, while a regularized Hamiltonian dual formulation supplies structured future-cost information through block-coordinate multiplier updates. No differentiation of the state dynamics or learned critic is required. The method is validated on nonsmooth problems with exact solutions, an analytical and learned ReLU biomarker cascade, an amyloid Neural ODE trained from longitudinal ADNI data, and three multidimensional-control problems with up to five simultaneous controls. Across these examples, HPDPO closely reproduces exact or reference objective values, trajectories, and control structures. The results show that forward simulation and Hamiltonian dual structure can be combined to solve deterministic finite-horizon control problems involving nonsmooth, learned, or black-box dynamics.

papers.title_en: Dynamic Programming for A Linear-Gaussian Dual Control Problem
papers.authors: Ying Wang, Yuchao Li, Håkan Hjalmarsson
papers.evidence: 面向最优控制问题的动态规划
papers.tldr: 针对含未知参数与高斯观测噪声的线性高斯对偶控制，本文研究无限时域折扣动态规划的信度状态代理模型，该模型保留高斯新息的前两阶矩及后验二阶矩结构。允许无界信度与控制空间、二次增长的非负阶段代价，并引入后验矩权重构造加权上确界范数。证明Bellman算子为压缩，最优代价是该空间中Bellman方程唯一解，且存在最优平稳策略。进一步建立值迭代、策略迭代与乐观策略迭代在近似误差消失下的加权范数收敛，结论可推广到一般加权压缩问题。
papers.abstract_en: We consider an infinite-horizon discounted dynamic programming (DP) problem for a countable-innovation belief-state model. The model is a surrogate for a linear-Gaussian dual control problem involving an unknown parameter vector and Gaussian observation noise. The surrogate preserves the first two moments of the Gaussian innovation and the resulting posterior second-moment structure. We allow unbounded belief and control spaces and nonnegative stage costs with quadratic growth in the posterior mean and covariance. Using a posterior-moment weight, we show that the Bellman operator is a contraction in a weighted sup-norm space. We characterize the optimal cost as the unique solution of the Bellman equation in this space, establish the existence of optimal stationary policies. We further prove weighted sup-norm convergence of value iteration, policy iteration, and optimistic policy iteration under vanishing approximation errors. The convergence results under vanishing approximation errors rely on general weighted sup-norm contraction properties and are applicable beyond the particular dual control problem considered here.

papers.title_en: On KL-Regularized Policy Optimization
papers.authors: Yifan Zhang
papers.evidence: 以闭式Gibbs解进行KL正则化策略优化
papers.tldr: 异步RL训练LLM智能体时，轨迹来自旧检查点或不同推理引擎，采样器与训练器概率不一致；裁剪重要性比率会带来偏差，GRPO则需对每个提示采样一组回复，长回合代价高。KLPO把KL正则项锚定在采样器上，使正则化改进步有闭式Gibbs解，并在采样器自身轨迹上最小二乘拟合对数比最优条件，无需重要性权重。消去回归截距后，难解的对数配分函数由采样器均值加采样器到训练器的KL散度替代，得到无critic、每提示一条rollout的更新，SPPO、GPO、REBEL、BPO均为特例。
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) for large language model (LLM) agents trains one policy on trajectories generated by another: rollouts come from stale checkpoints, and the inference engine's probabilities differ from the trainer's even at identical parameters. Standard remedies either clip importance ratios, which biases the update, or, as in GRPO, sample a group of responses per prompt, which is costly when episodes are long. We propose KL-Regularized Policy Optimization (KLPO), a framework that anchors the KL regularizer at the sampler. The regularized improvement step then has a closed-form Gibbs solution, and KLPO fits its log-ratio optimality condition by least squares on the sampler's own trajectories, so the sampler probability enters through a log-ratio and no importance weights are needed. Profiling out the regression intercept replaces the intractable log-partition function with the signal's sampler mean plus a sampler-to-trainer KL divergence. For token-level policy mirror descent targets, we show that the resulting gradient can be computed from terminal returns without a critic, via sampler-centered scores or a single trajectory residual, even under stochastic tool outputs. We further prove that independent Monte Carlo estimates of the KL term keep these gradients unbiased, derive the exact KL gap of cheaper top-$K$ and binary approximations, and show that SPPO, GPO, REBEL, and BPO arise as special cases of KLPO. The result is a critic-free update that uses one rollout per prompt and requires neither a learned normalizer nor a group of responses.

papers.title_en: Force without transmission: a depth-induced rank collapse that no loss on the representation reopens
papers.authors: Martin Hofmann, Patrick Mäder
papers.evidence: 削弱跳跃连接导致Transformer秩崩溃
papers.tldr: 训练可令 Transformer 陷入秩坍缩：所有 token 表示方向趋同，学习停滞。为检验表示层损失能否修复，作者削弱小模型 skip connection 制造坍缩并施加不同损失项。结果没有任何损失项能修复；问题在梯度路径断裂，任务梯度到不了 query/key，附加梯度也在坍缩形成层前消失。恢复 skip connection 不改权重即可重开路径，秩随之恢复。修复关键不是推力大小，而是梯度是否仍抵达需改变的权重。
papers.abstract_en: Training can drive a transformer into a rank collapse: all token representations point in one direction, and learning stops. In a related collapse of attention, a loss term with a bounded corrective force repairs the network during the run. We ask whether such a term repairs rank collapse. We collapse small transformers by weakening their skip connection and treat copies of the collapsed network. No added loss term repaired the collapse, although the stronger kind pushed with about a tenth of the task gradient. The reason was the path, not the strength. The task gradient no longer reached the query and key weights, which decide where attention looks, and the added term's gradient faded before the blocks where the collapse forms. Restoring the skip connection, which changes no weight, reopened this path at once. The rank then recovered, but only far above the scale of collapse. After a burst of high learning rate the path stayed open and the rank recovered untreated. Registered predictions from the path ranked recovery times but did not transfer to this cause. In every case the loss stayed above that of a healthy network after the rank recovered. Whether a collapsed network can be repaired depends on whether the gradient still reaches the weights that must change, not on how strongly a loss term pushes.

papers.title_en: From Digital Human Interactions to Physics-Based Humanoid Skills: Physics-Grounded Post-Training of Interaction Generators
papers.authors: Kerui Chen, Jianrong Zhang, Kai Lv, Hehe Fan
papers.evidence: 人形交互生成器的物理接地后训练
papers.tldr: 数字人生成的人体交互动作常依赖物理跟踪策略转化为可执行轨迹，但跟踪能力有限，许多参考动作无法成功执行，且成功跟踪也不保证物理合理与交互忠实。为此，DIGHT将数字人交互生成器与人形跟踪策略耦合为协同自适应框架：先在仿真中执行文本条件交互候选，基于跟踪误差、摩擦、漂浮及接触力反馈构建物理偏好，再用物理解耦扩散DPO对齐生成器，并微调跟踪器。实验表明，该方法提升了生成动作的物理合理性，也让人形交互在仿真中更可靠、更忠实。
papers.abstract_en: Recent methods have made promising progress in generating interactions between two humanoids, largely relying on physics-based tracking policies to convert digital reference motions into executable trajectories. However, limited tracking capabilities restrict the range of reference motions that can be successfully executed, reducing data utilization. Moreover, even successful tracking does not guarantee physically plausible responses or faithful realization of the intended interactions. In this paper, we introduce DIGHT, a co-adaptive framework that couples a Digital human Interaction Generator with a Humanoid Tracking policy. Our DIGHT first executes multiple text-conditioned interaction candidates in simulation using a fixed tracker. It then constructs physics-grounded preferences from the resulting rollouts, covering both general executability and interaction fidelity. Rather than collapsing these signals into a single scalar reward for candidate ranking, we align the pretrained generator using physics-decoupled diffusion direct preference optimization (DPO), preserving criterion-specific supervision without differentiating through the simulator. To improve executability, preference pairs are derived from tracking error, friction, and floating. Additionally, to improve interaction fidelity, we propose to incorporate force feedback from simulator as a measure of contact fidelity and construct preferences over contact occurrence, location, duration, and force magnitude. The aligned generator then supplies reference motions for fine-tuning the tracker, improving compatibility between generation and physical execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach not only improves the physical plausibility of generated motions but also enables more reliable and faithful humanoid interactions in simulation.

papers.title_en: Higher-Order Morphology Priors for Quadruped Reinforcement Learning Under Actuator Degradation
papers.authors: Derek You, Zafir Shamsi, Keqin Wang, Christine Allen-Blanchette
papers.evidence: 形态感知策略的腿式运动强化学习
papers.tldr: 执行器退化会让四足机器人行走变成需要关节协同补偿的协调问题。已有形态感知图策略在身体扰动下表现更好，但高阶机械结构是否带来额外收益尚不明确。作者将 Unitree Go1 建模为含肢体与躯干 rank-2 单元的胞腔复形，并用 Hodge 消息传递学习策略。实验显示，节点-边-面 Hodge actor 在未见执行器退化下回报最高、存活率更高且速度跟踪误差更低，表明高阶形态先验有助于全身补偿。
papers.abstract_en: Actuator degradation turns quadruped locomotion into a coordination problem requiring joints to compensate for lost actuation. Prior work suggests that morphology-aware graph policies improve learning and generalization under body perturbations. We ask whether these benefits can be strengthened by explicitly modeling higher-order mechanical structure. We represent the Unitree Go1 as a cell complex with limb- and body-level rank-2 cells and apply Hodge-based message passing. Under degradation training, the node-edge-face Hodge actor achieves the highest return on unseen actuator degradations, with higher survival and lower velocity-tracking error. These results support higher-order morphology as a useful inductive bias for whole-body compensation under actuator degradation.

papers.title_en: Dimension-Adaptive Accuracy Certificates for Convex Optimization
papers.authors: Egor Gladin
papers.evidence: 凸优化方法的精度证书
papers.tldr: 凸优化常靠仿射下模型证明候选解接近最优，但完整梯度在有效方向仅占未知低维子空间时开销很大。本文提出维度自适应精度证书，存储投影仿射次梯度并约束丢弃分量，且随子空间、查询与权重自适应更新。对二次正则给出精确修正与紧凑权重选择问题，并刻画压缩记录支持的最强下界；证书可用作提供有效仿射次梯度算法的停止准则。实验显示在核SVM和ν-SVR上可显著降低证书通信与停止时间。
papers.abstract_en: Many convex optimization methods use affine lower models to certify that a candidate solution is near optimal. Keeping full gradients can be costly when the informative directions occupy a small, initially unknown subspace. We develop accuracy certificates that store projected affine minorants together with bounds on the discarded components. The certificates remain valid as the subspace, queries, and certificate weights are chosen adaptively. For quadratic regularization, we derive an exact correction that accounts for when each discarded component was recorded, and a compact problem for selecting certificate weights. We also characterize the strongest lower bound supported by the compressed records when an ambient direction remains unused. The certificates can be used as stopping criteria for methods that provide valid affine minorants. We also analyze an adaptive cutting-plane construction whose oracle bound depends on the discovered dimension. Experiments on kernel SVM and $ν$-SVR problems show reduced certificate communication and stopping times under an emulated bandwidth constraint.

papers.title_en: A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control
papers.authors: Octi Zhang, Mateo Guaman Castro, Patrick Yin, Ignacio Dagnino, Abhishek Gupta, Rosario Scalise, Byron Boots
papers.evidence: 基于大规模并行仿真与多样重置的机器人控制仿真到现实强化学习
papers.tldr: 通用机器人需兼顾运动与操作，但仿真到现实的强化学习常依赖逐任务奖励塑形与示范，工程负担重。近期用多样仿真重置和海量并行环境缓解此问题，但均匀采样会把大量经验浪费在已掌握或暂不可达的配置上，限制超大规模并行训练的收益。为此，作者提出Success Guided Sampling（SGS），一种面向策略能力前沿的自适应采样器，将训练集中在最有益配置。在最高2^20个并行环境的实验中，SGS解决了多地形四足运动与接触密集装配等此前失败任务，并将操作策略蒸馏为RGB策略，实现真机零样本迁移。
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose robots must perform a wide range of tasks from agile locomotion to dexterous manipulation. While sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has proven to be a useful tool for this goal, current RL pipelines depend on engineering-heavy, per-task structural priors such as shaped rewards and demonstrations. Recent work has shown that diverse simulator resets, combined with massively parallel simulation, can alleviate much of this engineering burden on several manipulation problems. However, we find that naively scaling this paradigm to more precise or dynamic problems remains non-trivial. While simulator resets can help with exploration, uniformly sampling over this distribution wastes a growing fraction of learning experience on task configurations the policy has already mastered or cannot yet attempt. This makes it challenging to see the expected benefits of scaling parallel environments for RL, since much of the learning signal in a batch is wasted during learning. To mitigate this, we introduce Success Guided Sampling (SGS), a simple adaptive sampler that concentrates RL training on task configurations around the frontier of the policy's capabilities. Doing so allows large-scale simulated RL to make the most out of the experience in a batch, enabling much more effective scaling to large-scale parallel simulation. Across experiments using up to $2^{20}$ (over one million) parallel environments, SGS enables RL to solve challenging multi-terrain quadruped locomotion and contact-rich assembly tasks that prior methods fail to solve. Finally, we distill the learned manipulation policies into RGB-based policies and demonstrate zero-shot transfer to several challenging assembly tasks on real hardware. Project website: https://sgs-rl.github.io/.

papers.title_en: Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization: Unifying LLM RL Algorithms from the Perspective of Divergence
papers.authors: Zhicheng Cai, Xinyuan Guo, Hanlin Wu, Weinan Dai, Yuyan Zhou, Wei-Ying Ma, Ya-Qin Zhang, Hao Zhou
papers.evidence: 基于信任域理论的广义策略优化
papers.tldr: 大语言模型推理依赖强化学习，但主流PPO的裁剪代理几何退化，无法自适应容忍策略偏移，易过早裁剪并损害探索，后续变体多为启发式修补。作者提出GPPO，从散度视角统一设计LLM强化学习算法，建立广义f散度信赖域理论与单调性能提升保证，并引入更忠实的散度估计器拓扑。PPO、DAPO、DPPO、RIPO均成其特例，形成散度×估计器二维设计空间。在八个数学与代码基准上，最佳GPPO较标准GRPO分别提升最多50%和14%，达到SOTA。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has become the foundational paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Yet the dominant approach, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), relies on a geometrically degenerate clipping proxy that cannot adapt its resistance to policy shifts, leading to premature clipping and degraded exploration. Subsequent variants alleviate these issues through fragmented and heuristic modifications. We propose Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization (GPPO), a principled and unified framework for understanding and designing LLM RL algorithms through the lens of divergence. We establish a generalized $f$-divergence trust-region theory with a monotonic performance improvement guarantee, and show that different $f$-divergences induce distinct geometries and policy update dynamics. We further introduce novel estimator topologies that provide more faithful divergence estimates than the conventional single-sample Monte Carlo estimation. Under this framework, PPO and recent variants such as DAPO, DPPO, and RIPO emerge as special cases, establishing a principled two-dimensional design space of {Divergence $\times$ Estimator}. Extensive experiments on eight competition-level math and coding benchmarks show that both dimensions are critical. The best-performing GPPO instantiation surpasses standard GRPO by up to 50% and 14% on math and coding, delivering SOTA performance.

papers.title_en: Task-Space Imitation Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Salar Asayesh, Hossein Darani, Todd Cao, Evgeny Andriash, Mani Ranjbar
papers.evidence: 面向稀疏奖励机器人操作的强化学习
papers.tldr: 针对稀疏奖励桌面机器人操作，TIGER将动作分块模仿策略用作局部任务空间进度估计器，而非可执行控制器或动作先验。它通过控制器感知的动作到运动映射，把预测动作块转为短时末端执行器参考，并构造密集进度奖励，同时保留稀疏环境奖励为主导目标。预训练阶段利用模仿引导的前瞻信号，放松对有望取得任务空间进展动作的保守价值惩罚。实验表明，TIGER提升早期样本效率，减少安全违规，并在最终成功率上匹配或超越已有RL与IL-RL基线。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Task-Space Imitation Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning (TIGER), a reward-construction and pretraining framework for sparse-reward tabletop robotic manipulation. TIGER treats an action-chunked imitation policy not as an executable controller or action prior, but as a local task-space progress estimator: predicted action chunks are converted, using controller-aware action-to-motion mapping, into short-horizon end-effector references, and the RL agent receives dense progress rewards toward these references while the sparse environment reward remains the dominant objective. During pretraining, TIGER uses imitation-guided look-ahead signals to relax conservative value penalties for actions predicted to make task-space progress, reducing off-manifold exploration during early online RL. Across simulation and real-robot experiments, TIGER improves early sample efficiency and reduces measured safety violations while matching or improving final success rates relative to prior RL and IL-RL baselines on the evaluated tasks.

papers.title_en: Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning for Multichain MDPs: A Hierarchical Decomposition Approach
papers.authors: Huizhen Yu, Isaiah Heidt
papers.evidence: 面向多链MDP的分层分解异步值迭代RL算法
papers.tldr: 针对平均奖励多链MDP中最优增益可能依赖初始状态、递归结构随策略变化，现有RL方法难以直接学习最优策略。论文提出异步值迭代RL算法，仅需MDP转移图信息，利用Bather分解将状态空间按通信子系统与瞬态状态分层，并将全局决策重铸为结构化子问题。算法可在有限时间收敛到最优增益并得到增益最优策略。还扩展出近似求解平均最优方程与偏差最优的两个算法，且无需归约为折扣问题，为一般多链MDP提供首个本质无模型平均奖励RL方法。
papers.abstract_en: We study learning optimal policies in average-reward multichain Markov decision processes (MDPs), where the optimal gain may depend on the initial state and recurrence structures vary across policies, creating challenges for reinforcement learning (RL) methods. We propose an asynchronous value-iteration-based RL algorithm that requires no model knowledge beyond the MDP's transition graph and leverages Bather's decomposition to hierarchically partition the state space into communicating subsystems and transient states. This decomposition induces a recasting of the global decision problem into structured subproblems, which our algorithm exploits. We show that the algorithm converges to the optimal gain and produces gain-optimal policies after finite time. Building on this base algorithm, we develop two further algorithms: one approximately solves the multichain average optimality equations to obtain near gain-optimal policies, and another targets near bias-optimality by approximating the optimal bias function and solving an induced average-reward multichain MDP using the base algorithm. We provide almost-sure convergence guarantees for all three algorithms and empirically compare their tradeoffs, showing that the latter two also consistently improve transient performance relative to the base algorithm. To our knowledge, these are the first essentially model-free average-reward RL algorithms for general multichain MDPs without reductions to discounted problems.

papers.title_en: RFPO: Rectified Flow Policy Optimization for Embodied Control
papers.authors: Ting Huang, Lisiyu Pan, Haoyu Wang, Zeyu Zhang, Siyuan Qian, Yanjun Li, Yandong Guo, Boxin Shi, Hao Tang
papers.evidence: 结合奖励感知在线Reflow与PPO监督的流策略优化
papers.tldr: 基于流的策略表达能力强，但迭代ODE推理成本高，直接减少积分步数会造成少步离散化差距。RFPO通过奖励感知在线Reflow修正学生诱导的传输路径，并用冻结高斯PPO控制器提供全步与中间步动作监督。在Go2、Spot、H1、G1上，单步执行保持64步性能，回报差距在2.4%内；Go2单步保留98.5%回报，板载延迟从4.39ms降至0.08ms，加速54.9倍。该框架为可靠少步流策略控制提供了新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based policies provide an expressive framework for continuous robot control, but their iterative ODE integration incurs substantial inference cost. Naively reducing the integration budget can severely degrade control, since policies optimized under full-step execution are not explicitly constrained to remain reliable under coarse numerical integration. We refer to this mismatch as the few-step discretization gap. To address this problem, we introduce RFPO, a flow-policy optimization framework for reliable few-step execution. Reward-aware online Reflow rectifies student-induced transport paths during on-policy learning, making the resulting policy more robust to coarse integration. A frozen Gaussian PPO controller supplies complementary action-space supervision at full and intermediate integration budgets, while the deployed policy remains a single flow student executed with one Euler step. Across Unitree Go2, Boston Dynamics Spot, Unitree H1, and Unitree G1, RFPO consistently preserves full-step control performance under one-step execution, with one-step returns remaining within 2.4% of their corresponding 64-step values across both zero and random initialization. On Unitree Go2, one-step execution retains 98.5% of the 64-step reward while reducing onboard mean inference latency from 4.39 ms to 0.08 ms, yielding a 54.9x speedup. Real-robot experiments further validate stable one-step locomotion. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/RFPO. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/RFPO.

papers.title_en: Elementary cellular automata: spectral properties of Koopman operator for finite periodic realizations
papers.authors: Qingying Zhu, Serge Richard
papers.evidence: Koopman算子谱性质用于动力系统分析
papers.tldr: 初等元胞自动机（ECA）的有限周期实现是研究其动力学的重要简化模型，但对应 Koopman 算子谱尚缺乏系统刻画。本文针对该问题，研究有限周期 ECA 的 Koopman 算子，提出一种谱的表征方法，使谱能够不依赖初始条件而编码系统动力学性质。该谱包含底层动力系统的多种性质。基于此，作者对所有初等元胞自动机完成谱分类，并指出该工作为无限实现情形下 Koopman 算子谱分析提供了初步基础。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we study Koopman operators associated with finite periodic realizations of elementary cellular automata. The spectra of these operators encompass various properties of the underlying dynamical systems, independently of any initial condition. A characterization of these spectra is proposed, leading to a spectral classification of all elementary cellular automata. This work is thought as a preliminary step for studying the spectra of Koopman operators for infinite realizations of elementary cellular automata.
